data.display_address: Starlight Park, Mohammed Bin Rashid City, Dubai
data.long_description:
Starlight Park is a premium off-plan residential development offering modern design, elegant interiors, and a comfortable lifestyle in a well-connected community. With spacious layouts, quality finishes, and excellent amenities, it is an ideal choice for both investors and end users seeking long-term value in a growing location.

Features:

Modern and elegant design
Spacious layouts with natural light
Study room
Premium finishes and fittings
Open-plan kitchen and living areas
Floor-to-ceiling windows
Smart home features in selected units

Amenities

Resort-style swimming pool
Fully equipped gym
Landscaped gardens and leisure areas
Children’s play area
Dedicated parking
24/724/7 security and CCTV
Retail and dining outlets within the community
